checks.checks: Briefing at shift start naturally introduces where supplies are and whom to ask. Market closing before work, no guidance and payment terminal conflict respectively with schedule, briefing, and no collections. Broad payment terminal translation fixed; zh context otherwise faithful.

options.text: The market closes before the first shift begins.
options.zh: 市集在第一班開始前就關閉。
options.whyZh: 若第一班開始前就閉市，便與招募志工在市集開放時協助攤商及訪客的安排不合。

options.text: No instructions will be given to new volunteers.
options.zh: 新志工不會收到任何指示。
options.whyZh: 與所有志工都會接受說明的前句矛盾。

options.text: The coordinator will explain where supplies are stored and whom to contact for help.
options.zh: 協調人員會說明用品存放處及需要協助時的聯絡人。
options.whyZh: 這是前句簡短說明會的具體內容，承接自然。

options.text: Every volunteer must operate a payment terminal.
options.zh: 每位志工都必須操作收款終端機。
options.whyZh: 前文說志工不負責收款。

group.title: Weekend market volunteer call
group.passage:
The neighborhood market is looking for volunteers for Sunday morning. Tasks include helping stallholders unload, answering visitor questions, and keeping the entrance clear. Volunteers do not [139] ____ payments from customers.

The first shift runs from 7:30 to 10:30 a.m.; the second runs from 10:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. Please indicate which shift you prefer when you [140] ____.

All volunteers will receive a short briefing at the start of their shift. [141] ____ Comfortable shoes are recommended because most tasks involve standing. Water will be provided, so please bring a [142] ____ bottle.
group.passageZh:
社區市集正在招募星期日上午的志工。工作包括協助攤商卸貨、回答訪客問題及維持入口暢通。志工不會向顧客 [139] ____ 款項。

第一班上午七點半至十點半；第二班上午十點半至下午一點半。請在 [140] ____ 時註明偏好的班次。

所有志工在各自的班次開始時都會接受簡短說明。[141] ____ 多數工作需要站立，建議穿舒適鞋子。現場提供飲水，因此請帶 [142] ____ 水瓶。
